authority: Environment Agency via Defra Data Services Platform
verified_rules: the 1m composite DTM covers about 99 percent of England and represents bare earth after surface-object removal
the composite combines Time Stamped and National LIDAR Programme surveys and selects the newest best-resolution repeat survey
bilinear interpolation is used where source data is resampled
the published 2022 composite contains surveys from 6 June 2000 through 2 April 2022
GeoTIFF delivery uses 5km OS National Grid-aligned tiles
elevations are metres referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn with OSTN15 transformation for the composite
individual source surveys are described as plus or minus 15cm RMSE vertical accuracy
time-stamped DTM tiles vary among 25cm 50cm 1m and 2m resolutions and transformation depends on survey period
post-26 August 2016 surveys use OSGM15 while older survey metadata must be consulted for the applicable geoid model
WCS is the open-standard service intended to provide elevation values while WMS is a visualised service
